snippet.title: Spells & Secrets | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Unleash your inner Sorcerer in Spells & Secrets, out now on PC and console!

Features:
🌟 Customize your wizard student
🏰 Explore the ever-changing Castle of Greifenstein
💥 Master powerful spells and unlock more
🗺️ Delve into exploration like never before
👫 Join forces in local co-op gameplay
🌄 A world of fantasy, puzzles, and adventure awaits

🖤 Buy now on Steam: https://bit.ly/46wZyit 
💙 Buy now on PS5: https://bit.ly/3rwOfrL
❤️ Buy now on Nintendo Switch: https://bit.ly/46ilUVf
